SELECT company_name AS company_name, established_date AS established_date
FROM erp_companies
ORDER BY established_date DESC
LIMIT 10;
3b1bf73bbdc12d0a041c2bd9e2ce1077ac876da7:
SELECT 
    e.first_name AS employee_first_name,
    e.last_name AS employee_last_name,
    e.hire_date AS hire_date,
    e.base_salary AS salary,
    COUNT(DISTINCT em1.record_id) AS module_1_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT em2.record_id) AS module_2_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT em20.record_id) AS module_20_count,
    COUNT(DISTINCT em50.record_id) AS module_50_count
FROM 
    erp_employees e
LEFT JOIN 
    erp_extended_module_1 em1 ON e.emp_id = em1.emp_id
LEFT JOIN 
    erp_extended_module_2 em2 ON e.emp_id = em2.emp_id
LEFT JOIN 
    erp_extended_module_20 em20 ON e.emp_id = em20.emp_id
LEFT JOIN 
    erp_extended_module_50 em50 ON e.emp_id = em50.emp_id
GROUP BY 
    e.first_name, e.last_name, e.hire_date, e.base_salary
HAVING 
    COUNT(DISTINCT em1.record_id) > 0 OR 
    COUNT(DISTINCT em2.record_id) > 0 OR 
    COUNT(DISTINCT em20.record_id) > 0 OR 
    COUNT(DISTINCT em50.record_id) > 0
ORDER BY 
    e.hire_date ASC
LIMIT 500;
231e7c264095ccc910f4e3981edd8ba91d3c5dc0:
SELECT 
    p.product_name AS product_name,
    SUM(op.line_total) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    opportunity_products op
JOIN 
    products p ON op.product_id = p.product_id
GROUP BY 
    p.product_name
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;
7f8ec70a3940342c9360d2974461fdaf8f16f913:
SELECT 
    c.legal_name AS customer_name, 
    SUM(p.sale_price) AS total_sales
FROM 
    companies c
JOIN 
    products p ON c.company_id = p.company_id
WHERE 
    c.is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY 
    c.legal_name
ORDER BY 
    total_sales DESC
LIMIT 5;
32df322d15f9058a5dc89787dd56bfcd1ac00c35:
SELECT country_name AS country, COUNT(company_id) AS total_companies
FROM countries
JOIN companies ON countries.country_id = companies.country_id
WHERE countries.is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY country_name
ORDER BY total_companies DESC
LIMIT 10;
0ae0bd7684a3e2ed1799279b0a60c66f43804dd1:
SELECT 
    e.gender AS employee_gender, 
    e.employment_status AS employment_status, 
    AVG(pg.actual_value) AS average_performance_score, 
    COUNT(pg.goal_id) AS total_goals 
FROM 
    employees e 
JOIN 
    performance_goals pg ON e.employee_id = pg.review_id 
JOIN 
    performance_cycles pc ON pg.kpi_tmpl_id = pc.cycle_id 
WHERE 
    pc.is_active = TRUE 
GROUP BY 
    e.gender, e.employment_status 
ORDER BY 
    average_performance_score DESC 
LIMIT 25;
1e9c9648f1d8708a85247f101daa6159ad0e088b:
SELECT 
    c.city_name AS city,
    SUM(ec.basic_salary) AS total_revenue
FROM 
    employees e
JOIN 
    employee_contracts ec ON e.employee_id = ec.employee_id
JOIN 
    branches b ON e.branch_id = b.branch_id
JOIN 
    companies co ON b.company_id = co.company_id
JOIN 
    cities c ON b.city_id = c.city_id
WHERE 
    e.employment_status = 'active'
GROUP BY 
    c.city_name
ORDER BY 
    total_revenue DESC
LIMIT 25;
70b1e26487fa92f5b91a4e7031b7f2f8c1ef665c:
SELECT pc.cat_name AS product_category, pb.brand_name AS product_brand, COUNT(e.employee_id) AS total_sales
FROM product_categories pc
JOIN product_brands pb ON pc.company_id = pb.company_id
JOIN employees e ON pb.company_id = e.company_id
WHERE pc.is_active = TRUE AND pb.is_active = TRUE
GROUP BY pc.cat_name, pb.brand_name
ORDER BY total_sales DESC
LIMIT 10;
e32346411b744445b8fff4e2a428ae467b7201f9:
SELECT 
    jc.cat_name AS job_category, 
    COUNT(e.employee_id) AS employee_count
FROM 
    job_categories jc
JOIN 
    job_titles jt ON jc.job_cat_id = jt.job_cat_id
JOIN 
    employees e ON jt.company_id = e.company_id
WHERE 
    jc.is_active = TRUE AND jt.is_active = TRUE AND e.employment_status = 'active'
GROUP BY 
    jc.cat_name
ORDER BY 
    employee_count DESC
LIMIT 25;
